title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
description: From six melody notes to E/A/D bass, gentle offbeat picking and an optional F-sharp bass.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - First Melody Notes
lessons.description: Find six melody notes on the G, B and high E strings, without a timer.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Opening Phrase
lessons.description: Recognise the opening two bars; play, rest and repeat.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Middle and the Ending
lessons.description: Practise the ending and the middle before joining the tune.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Complete Melody
lessons.description: Play the complete twelve-bar melody twice, without bass.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - First Low E Bass
lessons.description: Add G bass on low E fret 3 while keeping the familiar melody.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Adding A-String Bass
lessons.description: Keep G bass and add C bass on A-string fret 3.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Adding D-String Bass
lessons.description: Add open D bass; choose between three bass strings.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Filling the Gaps
lessons.description: Practise gentle offbeat plucks over G, C and D.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - The Complete Fingerstyle Tune
lessons.description: Join melody, G/C/D bass and light offbeat plucks.

lessons.title: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star - Optional: The F-Sharp Bass
lessons.description: Optional: replace the D bass with F-sharp on low E fret 2.
